Candidate interfaces — outside the manager-shared API-01…API-10 baseline
• API-01 retains all authoritative live checks inside Submit MIGO. Removing Check MIGO removes only the standalone read contract, not posting validation.
• API-02 creates the SAP outbound delivery. API-12 is deliberately separate because it changes an already-created DI and has different preconditions and idempotency semantics.
• API-03 remains a provisional orchestration contract. The portal's one Generate Billing Documents journey does not prove one SAP LUW or one internal operation.
• API-05 is the sole stock-availability / physical-inventory read. It does not post adjustments; SAP revalidates live stock and batch eligibility before PGI.

- API-08, API-09 and API-10 remain independent STO read contracts. The v1.7 ZCNF_STO_SRV grouping is superseded: API-08 -> API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, API-09 -> API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=2, API-10 -> API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV. Confirm CPI pull versus S/4 push and reconcile the real-time row with Option C's Datasphere feed.
• Candidate APIs retain their own numbers so the manager-shared API-01…API-10 sequence stays stable and traceable to the functional interface screenshot.

ALL TWELVE sheets have been REWRITTEN as standard-first contracts. Each specifies the actual service or route, the operation/entity/action, request and response properties, the SAP field mapping, standard coverage, the v1.7 fields that do NOT exist in the standard contract, derivations, genuine gaps with named owners, activation status, required positive and negative tests, and a final disposition.

The speculative ZCNF_* custom services are gone. v1.7's envelope fields (RequestId, IsReplay, SourceSystem, MessageCode, TotalCount, HasMore) are no longer specified as SAP fields; each is listed on its sheet as a named gap with an owner - almost always CPI/T2.

Honest headline: API-05 and API-08 are the cleanest standard reads. API-01, API-02, API-09, API-11 and API-12 are standard with real adapter gaps. API-10 is conditional on $metadata. API-03 is a SIX-STAGE composition (stages A-F), NOT one SAP API. API-04 is a proven standard-OData DISCOVERY gap. API-06 and API-07 are existing DigiGST/EY routes that must be traced, not reinvented.
API-04, API-06 and API-07 returned ZERO candidate rows across the full 2,626-project SEGW catalogue screen. That absence is the evidence for their disposition, not a gap in the analysis.

API-10 AUBEL -> SalesDocument is UNVERIFIED. VBRP-AUBEL holds a PURCHASE order, but the released model names that property SalesDocument. Load-bearing for the STO-invoice join and must be proven against local $metadata before use. Owner: ABAP/SAP.
API-11 RequisitionNumber is FUNCTIONALLY OPEN - neither EKPO-BEDNR nor PurchaseRequisition is settled from one sample. Owner: Functional/business.

API-09 STO discriminator: DeliveryDocumentType = ZNL leads, category V supports. ZNL population validation remains OPEN, and delta is exposed at DATE grain only against a feed described as real-time. Owner: Functional/business + CPI/T2.

API-02, API-03, API-04, API-05, API-06, API-07 and API-12 sit on that shared spine and serve all three pillars. API-08, API-09, API-10 and API-11 are STO-specific. API-01 is the inbound side - receiving stock into a depot - and is not one of the three outbound pillars.
